What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Focused scope, faster pathOne system or one zone can be surveyed, priced and delivered without over-scoping the project.
01Ceiling replacementRepair or replace gypsum, grid and feature ceiling systems.
02Flooring upgradesInstall porcelain, vinyl, wood, epoxy or raised access flooring by use.
03Lighting improvementsUpgrade fixtures, controls and light levels around the existing layout.
04Partition and glass systemsReconfigure rooms with drywall, aluminium and glass partitions.
05Custom joineryAdd counters, cabinets, wardrobes, storage and display elements.
06Interior finishing upgradesRefresh paint, wall panels, wallpaper, skirting and transitions.

A process shaped for specialized renovation services

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Targeted inspection

Assess the existing system, substrate and adjoining finishes.

02

Scope boundary

Define exactly what is included, retained and protected.

03

Sample and BOQ

Approve the material and issue an itemized quantity-based price.

04

Focused execution

Complete the isolated scope with controlled access and protection.

05

Finish check

Inspect interfaces, clean the area and close out the work.

items.q: Can I book only one renovation service?
items.a: Yes. Specialized work can be commissioned as a standalone scope or added to a wider renovation.

items.q: Do you replace ceilings and flooring?
items.a: Yes. We inspect the existing substrate and services first, then specify the suitable replacement system.

items.q: Can lighting be upgraded without changing the whole interior?
items.a: Yes. We can improve fixtures, controls and light levels within the limits of the existing electrical system.
Yes. Woodex Furniture™ can coordinate counters, cabinets, wardrobes, storage and display pieces.

items.q: How long does a focused upgrade take?
items.a: Small scopes are typically faster than a full renovation, but timing depends on material lead times, area and site access.

items.a: Yes. Quantities, materials, labour and exclusions are documented before work begins.
